description: This file defines various parameter classes and types used in the FastAPI framework, including query, path, header, cookie, body, form, file parameters, and dependency/security classes. It serves as part of the core parameter handling system for API endpoint definitions.

classes.name: ParamTypes
classes.description: Enumeration of parameter types: query, header, path, cookie.

classes.name: Param
classes.description: Represents a generic request parameter with validation and serialization options.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Specialized parameter class for path parameters, ensuring they are required.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Parameter class for header parameters, with underscore conversion options.

classes.name: Body
classes.description: Represents body parameters in request payloads, including media type and embedding options.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Parameter class for form data submissions.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Parameter class for file uploads via forms.

classes.name: Depends
classes.description: Class representing a dependency injection container used by FastAPI providers.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: A subclass of Depends for security and authentication dependencies.
